Hello,

I'm launching a health and wellness brand on Shopify and am looking for a dropshipping partner for gummies and powders. I plan to launch with 4–5 products and expand the catalog over time.

I'm looking for a supplier that offers:

• Dropshipping and white-label/private-label options, with individual orders shipped directly to my customers

• A pay-per-order model: I pay only after a customer places an order

• Custom branding (labels, packaging, inserts)

• Quality and compliance documentation (cGMP certification, third-party testing, COAs)

Could you please send me:

1. Your product catalog and wholesale pricing

2. Minimum order requirements (if any)

3. Shipping times and fulfillment process

4. Shopify integration options

5. Sample availability

I look forward to hearing from you.
